snippet.title: Pikmon Flower White Official trailer.
snippet.description:
SPOILERS AHEAD

Please watch the entire trailer BEFORE reading the description.

Welcome to Pikmon Flower white! A rom hack of pokemon fire red set in the world of Pikmin. Catch over 170 unique creatures, fight familiar characters from across the Pikmin series, and uncover the mysteries of PNF-404 in this fan-made sequel to all 4 mainline Pikmin games.
After the events of Pikmin 4. Olimar has returned to PNF- 404 to lead a colonization effort alongside numerous castaways. Using specially designed onions, the creatures of the planet have been tamed and have recently been used in friendly competition, Pikmon battles! 
After returning to the planet following an invite from olimar, the protagonist of Pikmin 4 must trek across the planet and train their own team of Pikmon to become the best there ever was. But something is brewing on the planet, and with the sudden return of leaflings causing discomfort across the castaways, could something else be happening behind the scenes of this colonization effort?

New pikmon:

With over 170 unique pikmon to collect, the possibilities are virtually limitless! Enjoy well thought out stat spreads and competitive strategies allowing for almost all of your favorite little (or big) guys from across the Pikmin canon (and non canon) to be able to be EFFECTIVELY used throughout your entire play though. If you’re a big pikmin fan. You’ll have no problem finding a team that’s right for you, as our roster features almost every single creature from all 4 mainline Pikmin games as well as select picks from hey Pikmin and even Pikmin adventure! Create gimmicky, or ultra competitive team compositions with stat spreads created by VGC expert and competitive pokemon unite player @kyogre8466 

New sprites:

Pikmons art direction features hundreds of unique sprites created by talented sprite artists that were all made specifically for this project. Our team is proud to say that zero AI or stolen fan content was or will be used in the creation of Pikmon flower white, only official sprites from Nintendo developed game boy advance games and the incredible sprite art made by our amazing art team.

New shinies:

With a 1/4096 chance, every single encounter has a unique shiny form, almost all of which a reference to a different corner of the Pikmin community and franchise as a whole. For example, the shiny form of the burrowing snagret is based off of pikhackers interpretation of the burrowing snarrow from Pikmin 251 and more recently Pikmin 2 regrown. We have many other shinies ready to be discovered and connected back to the work of the Pikmin community!

New map:

PNF-404 is an incredible place with so much to discover, from the impact site to the valley of repose. From the blossoming Arcadia to the tropical wilds. Enjoy exploring areas from across the Pikmin series and challenging the gym leaders that inhabit them. You’ll find dozens of faithful recreations of iconic Pikmin areas as well as remixed interpretations of them lovingly crafted by our incredible map design lead, Turb0k.

Original soundtrack:

Enjoy a wide assortment of music made by our incredible music team directed by @mjtheshinyhunter  what you heard in this trailer was a cover of the Pokémon theme in the Pikmin 2 sound font, as well as the evolution theme based off of the end of day theme from the main series. The soundtrack will consist of many GBA covers of Pikmin series themes as well as original music made specifically for flower white! 

Complete fire red upgrade:

Pikmon flower white is built off the complete fire red upgrade by skeli789. Packed with newer pokemon mechanics such as the physical special split, fairy type, and many other useful additions. Enjoy quality of life changes and abilities past generation 3, as well as completely new mechanics and moves like the brand new move “bomb rock”

Mega evolution:

When holding a specific spicy or bitter berry, the creatures of PNF-404 can go even further beyond their usual limits when reacting to the player's mega spray! Mega spray combines with ultra spicy and ultra bitter berries to create mega spicy and mega bitter spray. 

Mega spicy Pikmon gain a speed and attack boost as well as a slightly altered form to turn the tides of battle. Pikmin types and space dogs can utilize mega spicy evolution, what you saw today was a mega spicy red Pikmin!

Mega bitter Pikmon receive a huge HP and defense boost as well as a completely new form, mega bitter forms bring out the creature’s secondary type to create a design completely new to this project!

Pikmon flower white is a project made by Pikmin fans, for Pikmin fans. We are taking our time to create something that truly celebrates the Pikmin franchise and the whole Pikmin community. Explore PNF-404 in a whole new light in this Pokémon inspired adventure set in the world of Pikmin! 

Pikmon flower white is planned to launch late 2026, wanna keep up with the project? Join our public discord server here!

https://discord.gg/skrpyAdDEY
